name: smwmusic-touhou-koumakyou-the-embodiment-of-the-scarlet-devil-incident-beginnings-a-dream-that-is-more-scarlet-than-red-remix
title: Touhou Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil - Incident Beginnings ~ A Dream that is more Scarlet than Red (Remix)
description:
𝐔𝐧𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐮𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐲 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐈 𝐝𝐨𝐧'𝐭 𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐝 𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐤𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐠.

Did an arrangement of the theme that ushered a new era of Touhou, A Dream that is more Scarlet than Red from Touhou 6: Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil. Returning to doing Touhou title themes after a year, and I took a lot of heavy inspiration from the Touhou Luna Nights version.

It's a great song that introduced the famous lemotif that'd follow future game theme songs, and it's simple yet very iconic. Hell, I even used it in some of my Mega Man remixes, lmao.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi, P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. D# Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. F Minor (MIDI Pitch)
3. E Minor (Custom Pitch)
